assumptions_and_limits: User dimensions interpreted as outward extensions beyond body edges, not existing safety buffers.
Body dimensions and sensor offsets are from a historical controller snapshot, not current live readback.
Travel-zone values are proposed targets for validation, not approved HMI input polygons.
Initial controlled test speed should be at most 0.1 m/s; measured stopping/reaction distance must fit the innermost margin.
Sensor coverage at arm and tabletop heights is unverified.
Stationary arm interaction requires a separately verified docking/manipulation mode; a fixed 2-D rectangle cannot both exclude tables and allow a gripper over the target tabletop.
Current navigation entry reapplies HAL level 2 from baseline geometry, so HMI-only changes may be overwritten.
visual_observations: Wooden cup table with wheeled feet projecting beneath the tabletop.
Glass partitions and aluminium frame members near the workspace.
Robot shown with an extended arm near the white table; video does not show the complete pick/place trajectory or a calibrated plan view.
A cable trails from the robot area across the floor; floor clearance must account for it.

docking_design.transport_mode: Protect the complete fixed-arm and cup swept envelope, including turns.
docking_design.stationary_manipulation_mode: Chassis motion inhibited while the right arm interacts with the verified target table. Preserve physical emergency/bumper functions and protect table legs, walls and other obstacles; do not globally clear front avoidance.
docking_design.unsupported_in_current_workflow: No verified automatic docking/manipulation avoidance-zone switching and no complete 3D arm-scene collision model have been established.
measurement_required_before_controller_w: Maximum left/right/front/rear sweep of both arms and gripper/cup throughout the recorded trajectory
Nearest table legs/feet and side obstacles at A/B
Sensor coverage and zRange reference at arm/table heights
Actual stopping distance at the intended test speed
Active controller polygons after the SDK reapplies level 2

clearance_requirements.note: Derived bounds from user-supplied approximate geometry; practical path must have additional allowance for localization and tracking error.

side_view_observations: Both forearms/grippers project over the tabletop while the chassis remains outside the table.
A 2-D projection overlap with the target tabletop is intentional during stationary manipulation; tabletop height, legs and edge clearance remain collision constraints.
This side view cannot establish the full left/right envelope or calibrated distances.

phase_requirements.requirement: Verified chassis stop and motion inhibition, right-arm trajectory checked against target table geometry; retain side/rear/fixed obstacle protection.
A separately verified low-speed, constrained approach/departure path to clear the tabletop before yaw rotation; not provided by the current simple A-to-B entry.
Use complete arm/cup sweep for path clearance; sensor height coverage and fixed walls/frames must be included.

travel_regions_reference: All distances measured outward from the full robot/arms/cup bounding envelope, not from the bare chassis and not directly from a sensor origin.
